answer.rationale: Deploy a referral incentive to established customers, where it previously added qualified revenue without measurable retention harm. Do not respond with broad promotional pricing: the recovered 40% SMB discount produced short-term signup and revenue lift but a 12% 30-day retention decline, making it unsuitable for the stated sustainable-revenue objective. Competitor-driven SMB churn pressure makes the immediate effect uncertain, so retain guarded measurement rather than assuming referrals will directly offset all price-driven churn.
